checks.scope: Checkpoint captions following a presentation are the bounded shape.
checks.observable: Delete-caption test distinguishes no subject from meaningful decision facts.
checks.consistency: Consistent with artifact links and real decision requirements.
checks.exceptions: Durable links, useful facts and otherwise missing discriminators are exempt.
checks.fix: Persist-and-link or name the subject supplies useful decision context.
checks.expression: The example makes the empty caption failure recognizable.

entries.rationale: The rule preserves useful context while removing a duplicate presentation label.

checks.scope: Operative criteria copied between a technique and linked resource are targeted.
checks.observable: Compare the actual criteria and ownership across the two homes.
checks.consistency: The general rule subsumes AP-105's linked-audit instance.
checks.exceptions: Pointers, scan scope and technique-owned procedure are sensibly excluded.
checks.fix: Unique criteria migrate before the duplicate is removed.
checks.expression: The ownership test is clear; catalog consolidation can reduce duplicate findings.

entries.rationale: Retain this sound general rule and fold in AP-105's narrower audit example.

checks.scope: Explicit attribution of an operative fact to a cited home is targeted.
checks.observable: Read the cited home and verify the attributed fact is supplied.
checks.consistency: Consistent with single ownership and actual reference reach.
checks.exceptions: See-also pointers without ownership claims are explicitly excluded.
checks.fix: Move the fact to its attributed home or correct the attribution.
checks.expression: Cannot apply the attributed claim from the home is a usable test.

entries.rationale: The source-claim comparison is concrete and does not need a quantitative threshold.

checks.scope: Reusable decision criteria embedded only in Protocol are well identified.
checks.observable: Lists, vocabularies and repeated criteria supply observable evidence.
checks.consistency: The thin-walker presentation remedy conflicts with AP-113.
checks.exceptions: Pure procedure and already-homed criteria are usefully separated.
checks.fix: Emit findings from the technique; let the activity present them.
checks.expression: Load, apply, present incorrectly places the last duty on the walker.

entries.rationale: Keep the criteria-home requirement and correct the final delivery instruction.

checks.scope: An audit technique copying another walker's criteria is targeted.
checks.observable: The copied paragraph also satisfies AP-102 in the linked-home case.
checks.consistency: Duplicate criteria are the same defect regardless of a second walker.
checks.exceptions: Thin scoped walkers are rightly allowed; independence also matters.
checks.fix: Consolidate the criterion-copy rule without banning independent verification.
checks.expression: One walker per home is broader than the duplicate-prose trigger.

entries.rationale: Fold the narrow instance into AP-102 and retain distinct coverage or independent passes.

checks.scope: Upper canon surfaces copying lower operational tests are explicitly named.
checks.observable: Named-citation substitution tests whether enforceable content is duplicated.
checks.consistency: A broader principle remains compatible with the specific lower test.
checks.exceptions: Short stance, unique homes and nonduplicating clarification are excluded.
checks.fix: Move unique criteria before replacing the copy with its citation.
checks.expression: The multi-sentence-copy distinction avoids banning all conceptual overlap.

entries.rationale: No numeric length threshold is needed; preserved enforceable content is the qualitative test.

checks.scope: Independent ordered or complete pass inventories are targeted.
checks.observable: Changes at binds can reveal separately maintained inventories.
checks.consistency: The sibling-Apply exception conflicts with AP-114's composition boundary.
checks.exceptions: Role orientation is rightly allowed; Apply exception needs removal or scope.
checks.fix: Pointer or generated summary closes duplicated inventories.
checks.expression: Intro says disagreement while Detect also catches accurate independent copies.

entries.rationale: Align the composition exception; describe inventory independence as the actual defect.

checks.scope: Multiple sequential outcomes under one Protocol heading are targeted.
checks.observable: Order dependence alone cannot distinguish phases from sub-actions.
checks.consistency: DP-15's single-outcome boundary is stronger than the disjunctive test.
checks.exceptions: One-write elaboration is exempt but overlaps the reorder trigger.
checks.fix: Split by distinct outcomes, preserving joint sub-actions.
checks.expression: Replace the sufficient reorder test with supporting evidence.

entries.rationale: Clarify granularity using outcome boundaries and a close counterexample.
